QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] The Fight for Fox-Justice
QuestInfo.0: Earn the respect of the Fox Yokai by delivering justice for an old wrong.
QuestInfo.1: Teach a lesson to the Humans who have been harassing the Fox Yokai.
QuestInfo.2: You sure taught those Humans a lesson. Regardless of whether they were the right Humans, you seem to have earned the adoration of the Fox Yokai on Kurama's behalf.
